draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.24, the 72nd-best grade among 259 2023 draftees and 7th of 30 at LB. He went 86th overall, close to where his grade ranked. Published comparison: Darron Lee. Testing standouts: 40-yard dash (95th percentile), vertical jump (98th percentile). College production: 73 tackles in 2022, 14th of 30 LBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 4 pro, currently with the Baltimore Ravens. 49 career games and 19 starts over 3 completed seasons, plus 4 so far in 2026. Trending down from his peak: 3 AV in 2025 against a career-best 6 in 2024. Strengths in 2025: sacks 2.5 (87th percentile), missed tackle rate 4.3% (81st percentile), passer rating allowed 84.8 (75th percentile). Versus the typical Year-3 off-ball linebacker who played: 66 combined tackles against a median of 40, above the norm.
